verdict.rationale: Sardine documents ongoing monitoring that alerts when an enrolled customer lands on a sanctions, PEP or adverse-media list. It also offers a case-management workspace for reviewing alerts, so the trigger behind a new alert can be reviewed. However, nothing shows a view of what changed between the prior state and the new alert, such as a diff, a history, or a changed-fields display. Missing for 10: documented change/diff view for monitored-customer alerts, alert detail showing prior vs. new screening results, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert

citations.quote: you can also enroll users for ongoing monitoring, which means that we'll alert you if any of your customers end up on one of these lists.
Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening, ensuring screening on both existing and new customers.
Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
